import sys

def calculate(ones, num, level):
    unit = ones[level]
    times = num // unit
    leftover = num % unit
    steps = times * level
    if leftover == 0:
        return steps
    pathA = steps + calculate(ones, leftover, level - 1)
    pathB = steps + level + calculate(ones, unit - leftover, level - 1)
    return min(pathA, pathB)

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    ones = [0] * 17
    for i in range(1, 17):
        ones[i] = ones[i-1] * 10 + 1
    result = calculate(ones, n, 16)
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
